title: Rory and the Silver Clover Hill
verses:
The sun had gone down in a blanket of pink,
As Rory walked up to the hill,
The evening was quiet and gave him a wink,
The breezes grew dreamy and still.

High over the ridges did Nia glide low,
To circle the soft silver crest,
While Psittaco chirped with a comforting glow,
And folded his wings for a rest.

Then Ricky hopped over the clover of green,
Where blossoms were falling asleep,
And Tilly stepped into the prettiest scene,
As shadows grew cozy and deep.

Then Benny stepped forward with footsteps so wide,
And hummed with a comforting sound,
He curled near the others and lay on his side,
To cuddle right into the ground.

Then Rory hummed softly a slumbering tune,
And tucked himself in for the night,
Beneath the kind smile of the silvery moon,
The world was so cozy and right.

The shadows had climbed to the canopy high,
As each tired dinosaur head,
Was rocked by the breeze in a soft lullaby,
Asleep in their fragrant green bed.
